# AniChin — Nonton Anime Subtitle Indonesia Terlengkap

> AniChin adalah situs nonton dan download anime subtitle Indonesia terlengkap.
> Streaming anime terbaru, movie, dan ongoing dengan kualitas HD 1080p gratis.

## About
AniChin provides anime streaming and download services with Indonesian subtitles.
The platform offers HD 1080p quality, daily episode updates, and a comprehensive
anime catalog including TV series, movies, OVAs, and ONAs.

## Key Features
- Streaming anime sub Indo HD 1080p gratis
- Update episode terbaru setiap hari
- Katalog anime lengkap (TV, Movie, OVA, ONA)
- Schedule rilis harian
- Bookmark dan continue watching
- User reviews dan ratings
- Search dengan filter advanced
- PWA (bisa di-install di HP)
- Dark mode support
- Multi-language (ID + EN)

## Content
- 60+ anime titles (real data from AniList)
- 453+ episodes with streaming URLs
- 17 genres
- User reviews and ratings (1-10 scale)
- Weekly release schedule
- Collections and recommendations

## Technical
- Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, PostgreSQL
- Schema.org structured data (TVSeries, AggregateRating, Review, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList)
- OpenGraph + Twitter Card metadata
- PWA (service worker, offline support)
- Accessibility: WCAG AA compliant
- Performance: FCP < 1s, TTFB < 300ms

## Pages
- Homepage: https://anichin.id
- Anime detail (canonical, server-rendered): https://anichin.id/anime/{slug}
- Anime List: https://anichin.id/#list
- Schedule: https://anichin.id/#schedule
- Genres: https://anichin.id/#genres
- Login: https://anichin.id/auth/login
- Register: https://anichin.id/auth/register
- English homepage: https://anichin.id/en

## API (for AI consumption)
- Health: https://anichin.id/api/health
- Stats: https://anichin.id/api/stats
- Anime list: https://anichin.id/api/anime
- Anime detail: https://anichin.id/api/anime/[slug]
- JSON-LD per anime: https://anichin.id/api/anime/[slug]/jsonld
- OG metadata per anime: https://anichin.id/api/anime/[slug]/og
- Search: https://anichin.id/api/search?q=...
- Genres: https://anichin.id/api/genres
- Sitemap: https://anichin.id/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://anichin.id/robots.txt
